picks.editorial_note: A Pritzker Prize for AI-enabled antibiotic discovery marks mainstream scientific recognition that AI-driven drug discovery (combining deep learning with bioengineering) can deliver real therapeutic breakthroughs against a global health threat.
picks.title: Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins win Pritzker Prize for AI and Science Research Excellence for work in AI-enabled antibiotic discovery

picks.editorial_note: An AI-guided vaccine design technique achieved complete protection against diverse bird flu variants in animal trials, demonstrating AI's growing power to accelerate pandemic-preparedness research well beyond traditional methods.
picks.title: Scientists are using AI to develop superior vaccines against viruses threatening global health

picks.editorial_note: Anthropic's pledge of up to $100 billion in equity to the public, alongside SpaceX's similar move, raises major questions about wealth distribution and public benefit from AI's economic windfall — a policy and financial story with outsized scale.
picks.title: Billions in SpaceX, Anthropic Stock Pledged to the Public. Who Benefits? - Georgetown University

picks.editorial_note: A $24.5 million NSF-funded national AI research infrastructure project (FabAID) with Nebraska leading cybersecurity shows significant federal investment in building secure, shared AI research infrastructure across institutions.
picks.title: Nebraska to lead cybersecurity for national AI research project

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's strategic framework with HSBC to build an AI & Emerging Technology Institute exemplifies deepening academia-finance industry collaboration on AI applications at significant scale.
picks.title: HKUST and HSBC Forge Strategic Partnership to Advance AI, Emerging Technologies and Financial Innovation
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: TUM's new government-backed autonomous mobility center, supported by up to €20 million in federal funding, reflects serious public investment in deploying AI-driven autonomous transportation in the real world.
picks.title: Autonomous Public Transportation: TUM Opens New DZM Location in Munich

picks.editorial_note: DOE's release of 'Genesis Agent Skills' with Fermilab shows federal policy-driven investment in agentic AI tooling for scientific research under the Genesis Mission initiative.
picks.title: ‘Genesis Agent Skills’ release to support innovation across the Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with robotics firm Unitree toward a joint lab signals growing industry-academia collaboration specifically targeting embodied AI and robotics commercialization.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Google.org funding to modernize fusion simulation tools with AI highlights industry investment accelerating clean energy research through AI-assisted scientific computing.
picks.title: ANU receives Google funding to boost fusion energy research with AI

picks.editorial_note: Tel Aviv University and Stanford researchers showing AI models can learn general predictive skills purely from self-generated synthetic data challenges assumptions about the necessity of real-world training data, a notable research advance.
picks.title: AI Learns to Predict the World Without Ever Seeing It
